display_information.name: Bank
display_information.description: A tiny currency for your Slack. Give coins with a reaction or /bank give.
display_information.long_description: Everyone in your workspace starts with 100 coins. Give them away when someone helps you out: react to their message with a coin emoji, or run /bank give @someone 10. Check your balance with /bank balance and see the leaderboard with /bank top. Admins can rename the currency, change the starting balance, choose which emoji are worth what, and adjust balances at https://labs.shebang.se/bank.

slash_commands.description: Give coins, check your balance, see the leaderboard
slash_commands.usage_hint: give @someone 10 for the fix · balance · top · history
